title: Honcho profile
description: One set of inputs for a pipeline run. The root config names the profile to use. Copy DEFAULT.yaml to start a new one.

apiVersion.description: Schema version. Bump it when a field is renamed or removed.

name.description: Unique profile name, lowercase with hyphens. The root config refers to the profile by this name.

description.description: What this profile is for, e.g. the role family or the experiment it tests.

dossier.description: The source material for this profile, typically a dossier containing the candidate's information.

criteria.description: Search criteria for this profile's retrieval runs.

style.description: Render style (fonts, sizes, margins) for the docx and pdf output.

path.description: A path relative to the Honcho root, starting with ./
